pages.text: With CC:Tweaked installed, a computer or wired modem beside a gauge reads it as a peripheral. Thermometers give getTemperature, getKind and getSignal; barometers getPressure and getTendency, hectopascals an hour.
pages.title: Computers

pages.text: Any of The Factory's electrical blocks, the solar panel among them, reads like a multimeter: getVoltage, getCurrent, getPowerUsage, getPowerGeneration, the network's usage and generation, and isPowered.

A mixer-settler stage gives getOrganic and getAqueous (fluid name and amount), getPhaseCapacity, isStirred and isOverStirred; a magnetomigration cell its getTemperature; an inert drum getGas; a bloomery getOre, getCharcoal and hasBloom. Tanks and the drum also answer CC's own fluid and inventory calls.
